<!-- pr-reviewer: 814182c289ff2fcae2f059480635d0fd0d00e81b -->
Read-only review (no worktree, no build, no cargo run). Checked with `gh` only.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

What holds:
- The diff is exactly one line in `crates/cl/tests/headless_bin.rs`: `arcs 30` becomes `arcs 33` in the `cl_bin_prints_move_stats` expected string. Nothing else changed (`gh pr diff` and `gh pr view --json files` both list only that file).
- The golden `crates/app/tests/golden/contour_disc_hole.cl` on `main`, counted by record type: Arc 33, Rapid 12, Plunge 6, Feed 18. Feed plus arcs is 18 + 33 = 51, and the total is 69 move records. The header says `moves=69`. So `moves: 69 (rapid 12, feed 51, plunge 6, arcs 33)` matches what the binary should print.
- The PR body names #839 (merged as 575f02d8) as the cause, has `Changelog: none`, and ends with `Fixes #936`.
- No golden, snapshot or source file is touched. Only the test expectation changes.
- `mergeable` is MERGEABLE.

Local results: not run by this review (read-only by request). The author reports `cargo test -p camcraft-cl` all green and clippy clean on this head.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking): the author's `cargo test` and clippy results are taken from the PR body, not re-run here.
